newsitem.title: USA: FHS to record $405.9 mln charge in Q2 - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: FHS to record $405.9 mln charge in Q2 - WSJ.

text.p: Foundation Health Systems Inc plans to record $405.9 million in second-quarter pretax charges and costs related to its recent formation through a merger, the Wall Street Journal reported on Friday.

The amount is much higher than the $175-$225 million the two companies that combined to form FHS -- Foundation Health and Health Systems -- estimated in a joint statement filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission in January, the paper said.
The WSJ said that while the charges are larger-than-expected, they may not deter analysts and investors.
Next week, the company will report a net loss for the quarter, the paper said.
Excluding the charges, the company's earnings will be between $0.49 and $0.51 per share, the paper added.
